title: Programmer Art Fix
description: A patch for Programmer Art / classic texture
author: THGABS
body:
Programmer Art Panoramas Bedrock Port - Classic Texture Fix ℹ️ While using this resource pack, make sure it's _above_ Programmer Art, or it may not work correctly. --- The [Texture Update](https://minecraft.wiki/w/Texture_Update) has been officially released in [Java Edition 1.14](https://www.minecraft.net/article/village---pillage-out-java-), while some players still prefer the old textures. Then Mojang has announced that **Programmer Art**, a resource pack with classic look of Minecraft, is built in game. However, even after so many updates and game drops released, it still has a lot of issues – and that's why I'm making this pack. This pack is also trying to fix issues found in Programmer Art, which can be found on [Mojira](https://bugs.mojang.com). Latest Additions
Features of this pack ## Textures ### Blocks ![Blocks featured](/launcher-preview/bodies/d1nRD7RG/0.webp) - Water - Dried Kelp Block - Blast Furnace - Smoker - Campfire logs - Cartography Table - Grindstone - Barrel - Composter - Stonecutter - Lectern - Loom - Wither Rose - Beehive - Smooth Quartz - Nether Wart Blocks (both, 1.16+) - Red Nether Bricks - Chiseled & Cracked Nether Bricks - All the Overworld wooden Trapdoors, except oak trapdoor - Crimson Nylium, Planks, Log tops, Sign and Door - Warped Nylium, Planks, Log tops, Sign and Door - Nether Gold & Quartz Ore (1.16+) - Crying Obsidian - Soul Soil - Soul Torch - Quartz Bricks - Respawn Anchor - Blackstone, Gilded Blackstone - Polished Blackstone, Chiseled Polished Blackstone - Polished Blackstone Bricks, Cracked Polished Blackstone Bricks - Copper Blocks - Cut Coppers - Copper Ore - Tinted Glass (with [connected textures](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity) support) - Powder Snow - Glow Item Frame - Azalea - Azalea Leaves - Cave Vines - Moss Block/Carpet - Deepslate & Cobbled Deepslate - Deepslate Bricks (normal and cracked) - Deepslate Tiles (normal and cracked) - Chiseled Deepslate - Reinforced Deepslate - Coal, Iron, Gold and Redstone Ore (1.17+) - All the Deepslate Ores - Calcite & Tuff - Dripstone Block - Mangrove Log, Roots, Leaves, Planks, Sign, Door, and Trapdoor - Mud - Mud Bricks - Mangrove Roots - Cocoa stage 2 model & texture fix (1.19+) - Chiseled Bookshelf - Cherry Log, Leaves, Planks, Sign, Hanging Sign, Door, and Trapdoor - Suspicious Sand & Gravel - Bamboo Block, Stripped Bamboo Block - Bamboo Planks, Bamboo Mosaic - Crafter - Trial Spawners, normal & ominous - Vault & Ominous Vault - All Chiseled Coppers - All Copper Grates - All Copper Bulbs - All Copper Doors - Polished Tuff - Chiseled Tuff - Tuff Bricks - Chiseled Tuff Bricks - Pale Oak Log, Stripped Log, Leaves, Planks, Sign, Door, and Trapdoor - Creaking Heart - Pale Moss Block/Carpet - Bush - Firefly Bush - Short/Tall Dry Grass - Leaf Litter - Wildflowers - Cactus Flower - Dried Ghast - Copper Torch - Copper Chests - Copper Golem Statues - Golden Dandelion - Sulfur, Potent Sulfur, Polished Sulfur, Chiseled Sulfur & Sulfur Bricks - Cinnabar, Polished Cinnabar, Chiseled Cinnabar & Cinnabar Bricks ### Items ![Items featured](/launcher-preview/bodies/d1nRD7RG/1.webp) - All the fish & fish buckets - Kelp - Dried Kelp - Phantom Membrane - Nautilus Shell - Heart of the Sea - Turtle Shell - Turtle Scute - Campfires - Crossbow - Leather Horse Armor (from Bedrock Edition) - All the Banner Patterns - All the Signs - Bell - Suspicious Stew - Honey Bottle - Honeycomb - New Dyes: black, brown, blue, and white - All the Netherite armors - Netherite Ingot - All the Netherite tools & Sword - Warped Fungus on a Stick - Music Disc _5_, _Relic_, _Precipice_, _Creator_, & _Creator_ (Music Box) - Copper Ingot - Spyglass - Raw Metals - Amethyst Shard - Candle - Powder Snow Bucket - Bucket of Axolotl‌ - Glow Ink Sac - Glow Item Frame - Goat Horn - Tadpole Bucket - Bamboo Raft - All Boats/Rafts with Chest - Mangrove, Bamboo, Cherry, and Pale Oak Boats/Doors/Signs/Hanging Signs - Disc Fragment (_5_) - Recovery Compass - Hanging Signs - Some of the item shapes and palettes of armor trims - Trial Keys, normal & ominous - All Copper Doors - Resin Clump & Resin Brick - Spawn Eggs for all the new mobs (25.1+) - Blue/Brown Eggs - All copper armors - All copper tools/weapons - Copper Nugget - Copper/Netherite Horse Armor - Classic Spawn Eggs for new mobs - All Spears - Sulfur Cube Bucket ### Mobs ![Mobs featured](/launcher-preview/bodies/d1nRD7RG/2.webp) - Drowned - Villager - Zombie Villager - Pillager - Wandering Trader - Brown Mooshroom - Piglin - Zombified Piglin - Piglin Brute - Hoglin - Zoglin - Iron Golem (Deleted useless parts in its texture file to fix [MC-112679](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC-112679)) - Glow Squid - Vex (1.19.3+) - Bat (1.20.3+) - All Wolf variants: woods, ashen, black, chestnut, snowy, rusty, striped, and spotted - Bogged - Creaking - Happy Ghast - Ghastling - Copper Golem - Skeleton Horse - Zombie Horse - Parched - Rabbit (26.1+) - Baby mobs - Piglet - Calf - Mooshroom Calf - Chick - Lamb - Wolf Pup - Kitten - Baby Ocelot - Foal - Baby Donkey/Mule - Undead Foal - Bunny - Baby Llama - Baby Fox - Baby Zombie - Baby Husk - Gurgle - Baby Zombie Villager - Baby Zombified Piglin - Baby Villager - Baby Strider - Baby Hoglin/Zoglin - Sulfur Cube ### Equipments - All Copper Armors - All Horse Armors - Saddles for Strider/Nautilus - Collar for Wolf (1.20.5+) - Harness for Happy Ghast - Armors for humanoid baby mobs ### Other entities - All Boats with Chest - Mangrove/Cherry/Pale Oak Boat - Bamboo Raft - Default Steve & Alex skins (wide & slim models, 1.19.3+) ### Paintings - _Baroque_ (cake, pot and sunflower) - _Cotán_ (golden apple & melon slice) ## GUI - Empty slots in inventory - Steve with beard on Spectator Teleport actions - Icons for Social Screen - Feedback icon in the new pause menu (26.2+) - Other widgets ### Mob Effect Icons - Conduit Power - Dolphin's Grace - Slow Falling - Hero of the Village - Instant Health - Instant Damage - Saturation - Darkness - Bad Omen - Raid Omen - Trial Omen - Weaving - Oozing - Infested - Wind Charged - Breath of the Nautilus ### Other - Particle of Crying Obsidian (purple → blue to match its texture) - Map icons for villages, swamp hut and jungle pyramid ## Models - Cocoa Stage 2 - Redstone Torch - Redstone Repeater - Redstone Comparator - Brewing Stand - Tripwire Hook - Dragon Egg
This pack is also available on [CurseForge](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/programmer-art-fix).

versions.changelog:
Update for Mounts of Mayhem

## Additions for Mounts of Mayhem
- All Spears (in inventory/in hand)
- Netherite Horse Armor (item/model)
- Parched
- Zombie Horse
- Nautilus saddle
- Spawn Eggs of Nautilus, Zombie Nautilus, Camel Husk, and Parched

## Additions/Changes on horses
- Skeleton Horse is changed, and Zombie Horse is added
  - Both of their textures have been reevaluated, based on their textures/models before the 1.13 model change, as well as their original design in DrZharky's [*Mo' Creatures* mod](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/mo-creatures)
  - For example, skeleton horse now has a short bony tail
- Entity textures of all Horse Armors have been changed
  - All their textures have been reevaluated based on their textures/models before the 1.13 model change, as well as their original design in DrZharky's *Mo' Creatures* mod
  - For example, their leg armors have been removed, while a small piece of armor has been added to their tail, which reflects their original design
- Zombie Horse now has an undamaged saddle when equipping it, just like other horses
  - However, it's still darker than other horse saddles to reflect its original design in DrZharky's *Mo' Creatures* mod
- Tint overlay for leather horse armor is back, as [MC-274828](https://bugs.mojang.com/browse/MC/issues/MC-274828) is finally officially fixed

## Other Changes
- All Netherite tools/weapons
  - Their borders now get darker, which matches the style of Programmer Art
  - Their patterns now get closer to their original textures from 20w06a
- Netherite Chestplate
  - Now consistent with which in the Bedrock pack, which is more Programmer-Art-styled
- Modified several pixels of Bogged

versions.name: [APRIL FOOLS] Programmer Art Fix - rv4.1
versions.changelog:
As you may have guessed, this version is actually an _April Fool's joke_.

---

To celebrate the release of a minecraft movie, this update has added a bunch of MOVIE-REALISTIC NEW FEATURES, CUTE HAPPY GHAST, IMPROVED TEXTURE DESIGNS, and most importantly - still in the CLASSIC TEXTURE STYLE!

## Noticeable Features
- Awe-inspiring  MOVIE-REALISTIC textures inspired by _A Minecraft Movie_
- Very reasonable features from _Classic Improved_ to enhance realism
- Retro logo from the older versions
- The panorama is now hidden and replaced with the old dirt background from Alpha versions
- Classic Cobblestone, Gravel, as well as Lava from beta versions
- Replaced unhappy ghast with VERY CUTE HAPPY GHAST😊
	- However, they will become unhappy again if they see any evil player😭
- Leaf Litters are now barely visible as they're ugly in vanilla
	- They will stay green unless in very hot and dry biomes like Badlands, Desert, Savanna, etc.
- Finally added the long-longed Blackstone

## Movie Additions in detail
- _I... am Steve!_
	- The original Steve is replaced with the Jack Black Steve
	- Advanced overlay feature for skin is used
	- Affects in-game player head, nausea & glowing effect icon, spectator logo, and the Realms artwork
- Added [Jens](https://x.com/jeb_)
	- Alex now has a pair of glasses, just like Jens
	- Wide Alex has beard while slim Alex does not
	- Advanced overlay feature for skin is used
	- Affects in-game player head and the Realms artwork
- Replaced the original cooked chicken with Steve's lava chicken
- Replaced the original Beacon with Night Beacon
- Villager-like mobs (villagers, zombie villagers, illagers, witch) now have ears, wrinkles, and more REALISTIC designs
	- Plains villagers/zombie villagers now have decorations on their cloaks
	- Illagers now have their eyebrows extended and their mouth more realistic
	- Nitwit villagers/zombie villagers and evokers now have a fancier cloak
	- Retextured villagers'/zombie villagers' savanna clothes in classic texture style
- Iron Golems now have a darker wierd texture, just like whom in the movie
- Zombies now have obvious hairs, just like whom in the movie
- Creepers now have a darker and warmer texture, just like whom in the movie
- Unhappy Ghast (when they see evil players) now have more realistic eyes/mouth, just like whom in the movie
- Glass block is overhauled and a bit more REALISTIC
- Piglin and Pig Brute are added to create a more consistent experice
	- Piglin Brute now shares similar dressing style with the other piglin heads in the movie
- Retextured golden tools to make them look like golds
- Retextured effect icons of Raid Omen and Hero of the Village to make them consistent

## Classic Improved Additions in detail
- Improved Magma block
- Purple Crying Obsidian
- Block-consistent Sugar Cane item
- Block-consistent door items of Spruce, Birch, Jungle, Acacia, and Dark Oak
- Block-consistent item icons of Item Frame/Glow Item Frame
- Cobblestone now has a consistent pattern with Mossy Cobblestone, just like the case before Minecraft Beta 1.7
- Mossy Cobblestone now has a brighter green, consistent with Mossy Stone Bricks and Moss block
- Both of the Cobblestones are combined with the classic pre-Beta 1.7 pattern and the smoother modern classic texture style
